a=1.05/18**2
b=8-2*a
y=8/(b+math.sqrt(b*b+16*a))
delta=math.sqrt(y*(4+a*y)/(4*(1+y)**3))
q=.385+math.expm1(.001)
qc=.385+math.expm1(.011)
out={'a':a,'ymax':y,'delta_upper_expression':delta,'q_family':q,'q_complex':qc,
 'seed_inverse_upper':1/(1-.385),'family_inverse_upper':1/(1-.38601),
 'tails':{str(n):{'inverse':.38601**n/(1-.38601),
   'variation_1':100*.3961**n/(1-.3961),
   'variation_2':200**2*.3961**n/(1-.3961),
   'variation_3':300**3*.3961**n/(1-.3961)} for n in [16,32,64,128]}}
Path(__file__).with_suffix('.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
